title: Research: certify staged544 internal-error reserves and arbitrary-dirty restoration
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The staged544 finite profile did not supply a source-bound transfer from faults inside its literal word to completed output error. This package supplies that transfer on both PR3945 providers and both prescribed orientations, with both original PR3734 words retained as controls.

Exact noncommutative forward/suffix/inverse-prefix calculations give **27 sufficient relative guard bits** for the declared destination-local arithmetic/native-warp error contract. Transporting faults into initial coordinates preserves cancellation; the direct unsigned-path proof needs 94/100 sufficient bits on the same words. The actual word has 17,598 macro instructions and 723 independent input blocks. All private buffers return identically and have **zero response into live outputs**, even with arbitrary initial dirty contents.

The full-state-cut extension explicitly allows defects in source/helper/private fields, as required when frame conversions affect more than an arithmetic destination: **25 sufficient absolute bits**, or **38 relative bits primal /37 dual**, under its stated aggregate-cut contract. The physical conversion implementation must establish that contract. The smaller 27-bit claim does not silently include unpriced source-field errors.

The norm is maximum register Hilbert norm. The 13-bit absolute instruction-error scheme also bounds actual intermediate magnitude below 1024 times the initial all-state bound. Per-coordinate quantization pays the separate sqrt(2d) dimension factor. Native internal arithmetic/workspace, exact borrowed-bit restoration under rounding, actual dirty ranges, owner stock/tape, all-size compiler and the selected-stage coefficient remain unresolved. 27 is not the selected stock coefficient. No selected κ or provider construction changes.

## Validation

Verification: exact rational replay across all eight source/orientation cases; forward and reverse free-operator matrices agree on all 723 blocks; independent dense scalar/Gauss-Jordan and noncommuting-unitary oracles; source, compensation, cleanup, dirty-buffer leakage and return mutations; optimized controls remain explicit. Registered replay, byte/history transport and standalone export evidence are retained in the package validation receipt and publication handoff.

## Task and overlap

Scope and source: canonical main 20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90, priority 6; PR3945 pinned 91f81d131252db704f945891da1ea54e29d46b8b. A changed scope of selected-stock-envelope is recorded honestly: this finite pending-producer coefficient does not satisfy the original selected-stage stock acceptance gate. Open questions identify one actual native/recursive macro budget and the authenticated caller composition.

Nearest predecessors are #3945 (changed construction), #3969 (relative word/owner audit), and #3957/#3970 (fixed-word edit searches and finite coefficient ledger). This adds source-bound internal error transfer and all-cut magnitude bounds, rather than another edit census.

## Open next questions

Prove one actual native/recursive macro defect and workspace allowance, then bind the caller's dirty range and ordered call sequence to the composition recurrence. Exact borrowed-bit restoration and the uniform selected stock map remain blockers. See the package README and ledger.
